visible_condition: surface creasing and wrinkling on cushions
hidden_risks: internal frame damage or broken wooden joints
sagging foam or loss of cushion support
hidden peeling or cracking of faux leather on the back or sides
response.best_proof: A close-up shot of the material texture and a view of the underside or back of the sofa.
response.failure_mode: Overvaluing the sofa based on clean front appearance while missing internal structural sagging or cheap peeling synthetic leather.
